Fixed. `paginate.js:7`:

```js
const start = (page - 1) * perPage;
```

Doc comment say pages 1-indexed, but code compute `page * perPage` — 0-indexed math. So page 1 gave `[4,5,6]`, page 4 gave `[]`. Subtract 1 aligns start offset.

`pageCount` was already correct — untouched.

Tests: 5 pass, 0 fail.

(One earlier failure was my own bad command — `node --test tests/` with trailing slash breaks on Windows, not a code problem.)
